hypothesis: When settled-cash admission alone would scale or skip a qualified fresh core entry, replacing a weak incumbent only when its remaining reward-to-risk is at most 2.0 and the candidate's reward-to-risk is at least 1.5 times higher may improve cash-feasible capital allocation.
assessment_scope: zero-new-outcome preflight; no strategy code or Gate-4 replay was run

locked_preflight_rule.candidate_action: full incumbent exit funding full fresh entry

short_circuit.reason: All three windows failed the preregistered minimum of 10 analyzable conflicts, so ticker concentration and outcome evaluation were not used to continue the experiment.

novelty_review.ticket_classifier_caveat: The reservation-time classifier mislabeled the gate as candidate_pool_top1_10d and reported 0.4953; manual fingerprinting restores the incumbent_rotation near-neighbor.

execution_clock_review.problem: Using official next-open prices to decide remaining reward-to-risk while also filling both legs at that same open is same-bar look-ahead and is not production executable.
legal_contracts: decide from signal-close or another pre-open observable input before submitting MOO orders
or decide after the open and measure actual post-open exit/entry sequencing, fills, costs, and slippage

rejection_reasons: honest novelty fingerprint is a blocking near-neighbor rather than a new gate shape
analyzable conflict density is below 10 in every standard window
the reserved same-open decision and fill clock is not executable without look-ahead
next_retry_requires: Park this cash-conflict face until a genuinely new source or gate shape exists, or at least 30 additional settled cash-conflict decisions cover at least 10 tickers and 20 dates; freeze an executable decision clock before any replay.
